question: If cot A = (1)/(sqrt{3)} , then what is the value of (1 - cos 2A)/(1 + cos 2A)?
solution:
**Given:**

cot A = (1)/(sqrt{3)} 

**Concept used:**

Cos(90° + θ) = - Sinθ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a23db5423203c244799bd5f8ad886b62945e07f7f1fd80840f5024758ff78cc.png] 

**Calculation:**

cot A = (1)/(sqrt{3)} 

⇒ cot A = cot60°

⇒ A = 60°

(1 - cos 2A)/(1 + cos 2A)

⇒ (1 - cos120^o)/(1 + cos 120^o)

⇒ [1 - cos(90 + 30)°]/[1 + cos(90 + 30)°]

⇒ 1 + sin30°/1 - sin30°

⇒ (1 + 1/2)/(1 - 1/2)

⇒ 3

**∴ Required answer is 3**
